ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis 30 #1 Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar oldies in a greatest-hits collection fit my listening, but other selections interest me more this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Platinum Collection: Greatest Hits I, II & III; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Queen fits my classic-rock interest, but I would save this large collection for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Cheek to Cheek suggests some interest in vocal collaborations, but this title alone gives me too little to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Very Special Christmas 2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I recently listened to A Very Special Christmas, so its follow-up is especially appealing right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadowland; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot connect this title confidently to the music I have been enjoying lately.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sounds of Summer: Very Best of The Beach Boys; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A collection of melodic '60s hits fits my interest in AM Gold and familiar older songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rubber Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My interest in Sgt. Pepper's makes another Beatles album a natural choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Joe Walsh: The Definitive Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my classic-rock listening, but I would prioritize the Beatles and softer oldies today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Guardians Of The Galaxy Mix V1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The nostalgic song mix appeals to my compilation listening, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Photographs & Memories: His Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Jim Croce's melodic storytelling fits the acoustic side of my Simon & Garfunkel and Jonathan Edwards listening.
